title: Lake Austin Private Boat - 2 Hour, Cooler, Swim, BYOB, Float Pad
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Boat Travel time is included in the total 2 hour trip duration.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience A 2 hour boat cruise on the beautiful Lake Austin while on a private, partially guided pontoon boat. The boat is equipped with a foldable canopy for optional full sun or shade! Our pickup location is only 5 minutes from Downtown at the Oysters Landing Boat Dock between the restaurants Quince and Hula Hut. Lake Austin has 22 miles of amazing views, including multimillion dollar waterfront homes, popular restaurants and some infamous landscape to see. Lake Austin is at a constant level allowing beautiful scenery for pictures & social media-worthy pictures. Many celebrities live on the lake such as Matthew Mcconaughey, Joe Rogan, Sanrda Bullock, etc. Reserve the boat for up to 15 people for a total of 2 hours & enjoy fun times on the lake. FYI: There are restrooms at the pickup and we can stop at the 1/2 way spot through the trip if requested when cruising.
